'''''Fantail''-class destroyers''' were [[Warship/Legends|warships]] made by the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].

==History==
Around [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]], Corporate Alliance ''Fantail''-class destroyers along with [[Sikurdian]] privateer vessels blockaded the [[Malastare Narrows/Legends|Malastare Narrows]] to settle a dispute over fuel allocations. In the subsequent [[Battle of Malastare Narrows/Legends|Battle of Malastare Narrows]], Alliance [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Trench/Legends|Trench]] lost his [[Trench's flagship/Legends|flagship]] and the blockade was disbanded.

''Fantail''-class ships later served in the [[Confederate Navy/Legends|Confederate Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Amongst other scenes, they were a prominent part of the Confederate fleet at the [[Battle of Belderone]].
